original.comparator: Ainglish full trailing with-action/with-entity clause minus shortest adequate explicit-English clause with the same event, resolved participants and broad association or actual equipment use
original.population: 256 prospective full clauses, equally weighting 8 named operational domains and both registered forms; 16 actor/object combinations per form/domain; entity-position cycle subject, object, other named participant fixed before tokenization
original.aggregation: maximum tokenizer mean over the 256 equally weighted complete pairs; form and domain breakdowns descriptive only

replication.comparator: Ainglish full trailing with-action/with-entity clause minus shortest adequate explicit-English clause with the same event, resolved participants and broad association or actual equipment use
replication.population: 256 prospective full clauses, equally weighting 8 named operational domains and both registered forms; 16 actor/object combinations per form/domain; entity-position cycle subject, object, other named participant fixed before tokenization
replication.aggregation: maximum tokenizer mean over the 256 equally weighted complete pairs; form and domain breakdowns descriptive only

study_context.study_scope: Fresh-input replication of the full-clause token_delta <= 4 prerequisite across both registered forms and the source's eight domains. It does not test comprehension, ambiguity resolution, robustness, adoption, ownership, necessity, or whether an association is instrument use.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

pin.estimand: Fresh-input token_delta replication of 396ffbe251fac5bbf3bb1ad0776148caa756ff54b831090a29a05c28ce51d902: full trailing with-action/with-entity clause minus shortest adequate explicit-English clause with the same event, resolved participants and broad association or actual equipment use; 256 complete pairs equally weighting eight source domains and both forms, with 16 actor/object combinations per domain/form and a fixed subject/object/other entity cycle; maximum mean across tiktoken 0.14.0 cl100k_base/o200k_base/p50k_base, aggregate only.

comparison_identity.comparator: Ainglish full trailing with-action/with-entity clause minus shortest adequate explicit-English clause with the same event, resolved participants and broad association or actual equipment use
comparison_identity.population: 256 prospective full clauses, equally weighting 8 named operational domains and both registered forms; 16 actor/object combinations per form/domain; entity-position cycle subject, object, other named participant fixed before tokenization
comparison_identity.aggregation: maximum tokenizer mean over the 256 equally weighted complete pairs; form and domain breakdowns descriptive only

estimand_contract.contrast: Ainglish full trailing with-action/with-entity clause minus shortest adequate explicit-English clause with the same event, resolved participants and broad association or actual equipment use
estimand_contract.population: 256 prospective full clauses, equally weighting 8 named operational domains and both registered forms; 16 actor/object combinations per form/domain; entity-position cycle subject, object, other named participant fixed before tokenization

aggregation.rule: maximum tokenizer mean over the 256 equally weighted complete pairs; form and domain breakdowns descriptive only

manifest.study_scope: Fresh-input replication of the full-clause token_delta <= 4 prerequisite across both registered forms and the source's eight domains. It does not test comprehension, ambiguity resolution, robustness, adoption, ownership, necessity, or whether an association is instrument use.
manifest.test_set_note: 256 complete fresh pairs: 8 domains x 16 actor/object combinations x both forms. No token-based item selection. English participial fronting states actual subject equipment use; relative clauses state only broad physical association with the named participant.
manifest.seed: none — deterministic generation order and deterministic tokenizer counts
manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before this process imported tiktoken or observed any new-item count.
